translations.web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
translations.bsb: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”
translations.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
translations.asv: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
